name: @quickreply/api
description: QuickReply billing API: TON/USDT invoices, on-chain payment matching, licenses (Cloudflare Worker + D1).

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply quickreply-billing --local && wrangler dev --port 8787
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply quickreply-billing --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.pretest:int: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.wrangler/int-state',{recursive:true,force:true})" && wrangler d1 migrations apply quickreply-billing --local --persist-to .wrangler/int-state
